location.id: Desa Lebak Wangi, Kec. Sepatan Timur, Kab. Tangerang
location.en: Lebak Wangi Village, East Sepatan, Tangerang Regency

participants.en: Elementary Students of Lebak Wangi Village

impact.id: Menginisiasi kelas literasi digital dasar dengan praktik Typingcore dan Microsoft Paint.
impact.en: Initiated basic digital literacy classes with hands-on Typingcore and Microsoft Paint practice.

lines.id: Merancang susunan acara dan jadwal pelaksanaan kegiatan pengabdian masyarakat KKN Digimapan ITB Ahmad Dahlan di Desa Lebak Wangi.
lines.en: Planned event rundowns and activity schedules for ITB Ahmad Dahlan's KKN Digimapan community service in Lebak Wangi Village.

lines.id: Menginisiasi dan mendampingi kelas literasi digital bagi siswa SD menggunakan Typingcore untuk latihan mengetik dasar serta Microsoft Paint untuk melatih koordinasi kursor.
lines.en: Initiated and mentored digital literacy sessions for elementary students using Typingcore for basic typing and Microsoft Paint for mouse coordination.

relevance.id: Melatih kemampuan menyederhanakan konsep teknis menjadi panduan yang mudah dipahami oleh audiens non-teknis.
relevance.en: Built practical experience translating technical concepts into clear guidance for non-technical audiences.

tasks.id: Menyusun rundown kegiatan dan mengoordinasikan jalannya acara KKN Digimapan ITB Ahmad Dahlan di Desa Lebak Wangi.
tasks.en: Prepared activity rundowns and coordinated events for ITB Ahmad Dahlan's KKN Digimapan in Lebak Wangi Village.

tasks.id: Mengusulkan program pengenalan komputer tingkat Sekolah Dasar menggunakan Typingcore dan Microsoft Paint.
tasks.en: Proposed an elementary computer introduction program using Typingcore and Microsoft Paint.

tasks.id: Mendampingi siswa secara bergiliran dalam kelompok kecil agar setiap anak dapat mempraktikkan penggunaan laptop secara langsung.
tasks.en: Guided students in rotating small groups so each child had direct hands-on practice on a laptop.

result.id: Kegiatan literasi digital berjalan lancar dengan antusiasme tinggi dari siswa dalam mengenali fungsi papan ketik dan pengoperasian dasar komputer.
result.en: Delivered smooth, high-engagement digital literacy sessions where students gained familiarity with keyboard layouts and basic computer operation.

participants.id: Pengelola Sekolah, Guru & Calon Orang Tua Murid

impact.en: Increased school administrative efficiency by up to 50%.

lines.id: Merancang dan membangun website landing page serta Content Management System untuk informasi sekolah, mencakup manajemen konten dinamis, data guru, dan kurikulum mata pelajaran.
lines.en: Designed and built a landing page website and Content Management System for school information, covering dynamic content management, teacher data, and subject curriculum.

lines.id: Meningkatkan efisiensi administrasi sekolah hingga 50% melalui digitalisasi pendataan profil guru dan silabus kegiatan.
lines.en: Increased school administrative efficiency by up to 50% through the digitization of teacher profile records and activity syllabi.

lines.id: Mengembangkan tampilan website yang responsif di perangkat mobile dan desktop untuk mempermudah calon orang tua murid mengakses informasi sekolah.
lines.en: Developed a responsive website interface across mobile and desktop devices so prospective parents can easily access school information.

relevance.id: Menata data administrasi manual ke dalam struktur database yang rapi dan konsisten.
relevance.en: Structured manual administrative records into a clean, consistent database schema.

tasks.id: Merancang dan membangun website landing page serta Content Management System untuk informasi sekolah, mencakup manajemen konten dinamis, data guru, dan kurikulum mata pelajaran.
tasks.en: Designed and built a landing page website and Content Management System for school information, covering dynamic content management, teacher data, and subject curriculum.

tasks.id: Mendigitalisasi alur pendataan profil guru dan silabus kegiatan agar terpusat di dalam sistem.
tasks.en: Digitized teacher profile and activity syllabus recordkeeping into a centralized system.

tasks.id: Mengembangkan tampilan website yang responsif di perangkat mobile dan desktop bagi calon orang tua murid.
tasks.en: Developed a responsive web interface across mobile and desktop devices for prospective parents.

result.id: Meningkatkan efisiensi administrasi sekolah hingga 50% melalui digitalisasi pendataan profil guru dan silabus kegiatan, serta mempermudah akses informasi sekolah bagi calon orang tua murid.
result.en: Increased school administrative efficiency by up to 50% through teacher profile and syllabus digitization while making school information easily accessible to prospective parents.
